visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Split into Words and Capitalise Each
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A flag and a character loop capitalise the words. Split the sentence into words, capitalise the first letter of each, and join them again. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Working word by word matches how people think about the task and removes the state flag. String.join puts the words back together with single spaces.
